name: Deli Style Cauliflower, Olive & Egg Salad Over Mixed Greens
instructions: Place eggs in a medium saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
Meanwhile, fill a separate, large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Cut into small, bite-sized florets.
Once the water in the large pot comes to a boil, uncover, add cauliflower and salt; stir for a few seconds. Cook until crisp-tender, about 3 minutes. Drain and set aside to cool.
Add mayonnaise, Dijon, vinegar, and spices to a large bowl; whisk together.
Peel and mince shallot. Small dice celery (reserving celery leaves for garnish); transfer both to the bowl with the dressing.
Using a knife, shave the dill leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Halve the olives lengthwise; add dill and olives to the bowl.
Peel and roughly chop the eggs. Add eggs and drained cauliflower to the bowl; stir to combine.
In a small bowl, whisk together oil, vinegar, Dijon, and spices to make a dressing for the mixed greens.
To serve, divide mixed greens between plates or bowls; drizzle dressing over greens and top with cauliflower salad. Garnish with celery leaves and enjoy!
author: Mealime
